items.e: ...And the Arizal writes that a measure of Mishnayos [should] take precedence over everything, and through this one merits "neshama"...

Three steps. Look at the Magen Avraham. And it is obvious that it is talking about (when the person in front) is within 4 Amos (of the person behind), or if he will enter the 4 Amos by stepping the three steps backwards, Olat Tamid.
Seven times. The reason is to accompany the Shechinah that rises upwards through the seven heavenly firmaments.
